name: Software Development for Embedded Telecommunication Systems
description: Exposure to usage and internals of modern general-purpose and real-time operating systems, use of formal software development life cycle (SDLC), use of software patterns and frameworks, software architectures along with client-server architectures, prompt engineering and vibe coding for modern programming languages beginning with C/C++/D and React, Go, React, Rust, JavaScript/NodeJS inter alia, system-level software development with kernel-level programming.
